description: This PHP class 'DirectoryWithMetadataDiscovery' extends 'YamlDirectoryDiscovery' and handles discovering directories with metadata files, specifically YAML component files, within the Drupal framework. It includes methods for iterating over directories, filtering files, generating unique identifiers for components, and finding providers based on directory paths.

classes.name: DirectoryWithMetadataDiscovery
classes.description: A class responsible for discovering directories containing YAML component metadata files within Drupal, with methods for directory iteration, file filtering, and provider identification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the discovery with directories, cache suffix, and optionally a file system service, with a deprecation warning if the file system service is used.

methods.name: getDirectoryIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over files in a directory, filtering for specific YAML component files.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for a component based on the filename and provider.

methods.name: findProvider
methods.description: Recursively determines the provider name based on the file's directory path.
